data.one_liner: Adds mention and tagging capabilities to TextField or TextFormField widgets in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Extends standard text fields to support user mentions and tags using custom trigger symbols like '@' or '#'. It provides a custom controller to track mentions, retrieve data associated with tags, and handle custom styling or removal of mentions.
use_when: You need to implement social media-style tagging or mentioning in a text input field.
You want to associate structured data (like user objects) with specific text mentions.
avoid_when: You need complex rich-text editing beyond basic mentions and tags.
You are not using standard TextField or TextFormField widgets.
strengths: Supports multiple mention symbols and custom styling per mention.
Handles automatic backspace removal and incremental mention deletion.
Provides initial mention support and easy access to mention data and text.
weaknesses: Limited to mention and tagging use cases on top of existing text fields.
Requires manual removal through the controller rather than direct list manipulation.
